name: Oc nui luoc
summary: Boiled mountain snail, written as luộc xả hết, on the Tam Coc table from April to August.
origin: Restaurants at Tam Coc, from April to August.
howToEat: Order it from April to August, when the snails come out of the rock caves. The phrase luộc xả hết is not a lemongrass recipe.
seoTitle: Oc nui luoc — boiled mountain snail
seoDescription: Boiled mountain snail in Tam Coc, written as luộc xả hết, from April to August.
